caption:
133,371 reviews on one blackout curtain. That's not a coincidence.

Most curtains on Amazon top out at a few hundred reviews. This one has over 133,000, at a 4.6-star average, in the 42-inch by 63-inch size. That kind of volume usually means people are still buying it years after the first review went up.

These are blackout panels sized for a standard bedroom window, sold as a 2-panel set. A 4.6 rating held across 133,371 reviews suggests the room-darkening claim holds up for most buyers, not just the first few hundred.

If your window still lets in streetlight or early sun, a tested pair at $9.98 is a low-risk swap to make before buying anything pricier.
